prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single universally “best” dentist for implants in Atlanta — the right provider depends on your needs (single tooth vs full-arch, bone loss or grafting required, sedation needs, budget). To get the best outcome, look for a specialist with specific implant experience and good outcomes. Here’s how to find one and what to ask.

Who to consider
- Oral and maxillofacial surgeons (OMS): surgical expertise for difficult extractions, bone grafts, and multiple implants. Often handle complex cases and IV sedation.
- Periodontists: specialize in the gums and supporting bone; many place implants and do grafting.
- Prosthodontists: specialists in restoring teeth and making implant crowns/bridges; best for complex aesthetic or full-mouth restorations.
Many excellent practices combine these skills (a surgeon places the implant, a prosthodontist/ restorative dentist completes the crown).

What to look for
- Specialty training and board certification (ABOMS for OMS, American Board of Periodontology, American Board of Prosthodontics when applicable).
- High implant volume and case examples (before/after photos).
- Use of modern tech: CBCT (3D imaging), guided implant planning, intraoral scanning.
- Good reviews and verifiable patient outcomes.
- Clear treatment plan, timeline, costs, and follow-up/maintenance care.
- Comfort/sedation options if you’re anxious.
- Local referrals from your general dentist or Emory/academic faculty (Emory-affiliated oral surgeons and dental faculty are often a good resource).

Questions to ask during a consult
- How many implants do you place each year? Are you board certified?
- Who will do the surgery and who will do the crown/restoration?
- Do you use CBCT and guided surgery?
- What implant brand do you use and why?
- Will I need bone grafting or sinus lift? How do you handle complications?
- What is the total cost (surgery, implant, abutment, crown) and financing options?
- Can I see before/after photos or patient references?
- What is the post-op care plan and emergency access?

How I can help right now
- If you tell me your ZIP code, whether you prefer a specialist type (OMS, periodontist, prosthodontist), and if you have insurance, I can look up top-rated providers and give a short list of practices in Atlanta for you to consider.
